Name: Tiny Farmhouse
Author: badgerbadgerbadger13
Description:
[b][size=5]I'm currently (as of May 2023) on a break both from playing and modding Stardew Valley. I will not answer comments or upload any bug fixes or new versions of this mod for a while. [b]If you want to publish any fixes for or edits of this mod that's fine by me, BUT [b][size=5][b]please check with Jhoulana first[/b][/size][/b] (as they're the creator of the map I based my edits on).[/b] Thank you all for downloading and commenting! <3

(23/04/2024) There is now a 1.6 update for this mod made by clownedcat [/size][/b][b][size=5]available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22990/?tab=description]here![/url] [/size][/b]

This mod is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9721]Farmhouse by Robin's Vision[/url]. It's an edit of Jhoulana's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11926]My First Farmhouse with Kitchen[/url], and they graciously allowed me to publish my edits as a mod.

The kitchen is not usable until you upgrade the farmhouse for the first time. Spouses and roommates work, but some days they'll hang out in the void. The spouse room is hidden by default, but there's a toggle in the config files. Turning on the spouse room makes it less likely your spouses/roommates will spend time in the void, but your house will be bigger. If you turn on the spouse room and it looks weird, save the game and restart. All the house renovations should work, but the added rooms will be smaller. [i]I've not tested it with children[/i].

[b]Works with:[/b]
[list]
[*]Cellar-map edits, just make sure my mod loads after. I've added an edit to the cellar warp so your farmer should enter in the correct part of the farmhouse if you exit from the cellar.
[*]Recolors, I've only used tiles from the original farmhouse map and the towninterior map (for the first farmhouse)
[/list][b]
[/b][b]Mods in screenshots:[/b]
[list]

[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNikos's Earthy's Interiors[/url]﻿ [/b]- The interior.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2331]Enhanced Player Sprites[/url]﻿ - The farmer sprites.
[*][url=http://github.com/Annosz/UIInfoSuite2/releases]Unofficial update of UI Info Suite[/url]﻿ - The extra information under the clock.
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14644]West Elm Furniture (AT) by Atlas[/url]﻿ [/b]-[b] [/b]Alternative textures for the furniture.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599]Professor Jasper Thomas [/url]﻿- Lemurkat's lovely professor.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url]﻿ - Want to live with everyone? Well now you can!
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9642]The Last Smoluanu[/url]﻿ - A dwarf expansion by Lemurkat.
